title: Reporter CRISPR screens decipher cis-regulatory and trans-regulatory principles at the Xist locus
model: Female mouse ES cells, day 2 of differentiation, CRISPRi of transcription-factor promoters, sorted by Xist RNA FlowFISH
contrast: Xist-high vs Xist-negative sort, paired by replicate (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: ZIC3 and other X-linked factors activate Xist; 13 promoters at MLE FDR 0.10
verdict: BARCS and the authors' MAGeCK-MLE agree closely (rank correlation 0.95; 8 of the top 10 shared): Xist's own promoter, Zic3 and Rlim deplete from Xist-high cells and Tsix knockdown enriches them. BARCS calls far more promoters at FDR 0.10 (101 vs 13) from one residual degree of freedom, so its longer list leans on dispersion moderation.
